related_questions.question: What is the 11 meter rule?
related_questions.snippet: The BSA establishes a height threshold of 11 metres (approximately 36 feet) as a key factor in determining whether a building falls under the definition of a “relevant building.” Buildings exceeding this height threshold are generally considered higher-risk and subject to stricter fire safety regulations.
